recommended_phases.title: Phase 1: Shared types — LeaveType and LeaveStatus enums
recommended_phases.rationale: Zero-dependency foundation. Every downstream module imports these enums. Must exist first.

recommended_phases.title: Phase 2: Audit module
recommended_phases.rationale: No dependencies on other domain modules. Required by balance and leave for GP-002 audit writes on all state changes.

recommended_phases.title: Phase 3: Employee module
recommended_phases.rationale: No domain dependencies. Provides employee lookup and manager/team queries needed by leave approval flow.

recommended_phases.title: Phase 4: Policy module
recommended_phases.rationale: Depends only on shared-types. Encodes leave-type rules (max days, blackout dates, eligibility) that leave submission validates against.

recommended_phases.title: Phase 5: Balance module
recommended_phases.rationale: Depends on shared-types and audit. Manages leave balance lifecycle — initialization, deduction on approval, restoration on rejection/cancellation.

recommended_phases.title: Phase 6: Notification module
recommended_phases.rationale: No domain dependencies. Fire-and-forget notifications for leave lifecycle events. Can be built in parallel with phases 3-5.

recommended_phases.title: Phase 7: Leave module — model and contracts
recommended_phases.rationale: LeaveRequest model, ILeaveRepository, ILeaveService. Depends on shared-types only. Defines the contracts that phase 8 implements.

recommended_phases.title: Phase 8: Leave module — repository and service implementation
recommended_phases.rationale: Implements ILeaveRepository and ILeaveService. Orchestrates policy validation, balance deduction/restoration, audit writes, and notifications.

recommended_phases.title: Phase 9: Leave module — controller and routes
recommended_phases.rationale: Fastify route handlers with RBAC guards. Exposes the REST API surface for leave operations.

recommended_phases.title: Phase 10: Module index files
recommended_phases.rationale: Public entry points (index.ts) for employee, policy, balance, and leave modules. Enforces the rule that modules only import from each other's index.ts.

app_notes: Layer boundaries: presentation (controller + routes), application (service interfaces + implementations), domain (models), infrastructure (repositories, db connection). Dependencies flow inward: routes → controller → service → repository → db. LeaveService orchestrates across policy, balance, audit, and notification — it is the single transaction boundary for submit/approve/reject/cancel. All state-changing operations write audit records (GP-002). RBAC is enforced at the route level via a requireRole guard, never inline in services. The leave module's public entry point is src/modules/leave/index.ts; other modules import only from that file.

open_questions.question: Should leave balance be allowed to go negative when an employee submits a request exceeding their remaining balance?
open_questions.impact: Affects both IPolicyService.validateLeaveRequest (pre-submission gate) and IBalanceService.deductBalance (post-approval execution). If negative balances are forbidden, validateLeaveRequest must check balance sufficiency; if allowed, the policy check is softer. The choice also affects the restoreBalance semantics on rejection/cancellation.
candidate_options: Hard block: validateLeaveRequest rejects if days > remaining balance; deductBalance never goes negative
Soft allow: validateLeaveRequest warns but permits; deductBalance can go negative; HR resolves overages manually
Configurable per leave type: annual leave allows negative up to a threshold; sick/emergency never blocks

open_questions.question: How are leave balances accrued — annual lump-sum reset, monthly pro-rata, or continuous accrual?
open_questions.impact: Determines whether IBalanceService needs an accrueBalance method, whether a BullMQ scheduled job is required, and how initializeBalance seeds the fiscal year. Without this decision, the balance module's lifecycle is incomplete.
candidate_options: Annual lump-sum: initializeBalance sets full entitlement at fiscal year start; no accrual job needed
Monthly pro-rata: BullMQ job accrues 1/12 of entitlement each month; initializeBalance seeds partial year
Continuous daily accrual: BullMQ job runs daily; balance grows incrementally

auth_contract: request.user: { id: string; role: UserRole } where UserRole = 'employee' | 'manager' | 'hr_admin'. JWT bearer token verified by an auth middleware (fastify.addHook) that populates request.user. RBAC enforced by a requireRole(...roles) route-level guard invoked in route definitions — never inline in controllers or services.
error_response_contract: Standard error shape: { error: string; code: string }. Validation failure → HTTP 400 (code: VALIDATION_ERROR). Authentication failure → HTTP 401 (code: UNAUTHORIZED). Authorization failure → HTTP 403 (code: FORBIDDEN). Not found → HTTP 404 (code: NOT_FOUND). Internal server error → HTTP 500 (code: INTERNAL_ERROR).
